text.en:
Mhe qualifications for appointment to the position of Solicitor
Ceneral and Assistant Solicitor General shall be the same as those
prescribed for judges of Courts of First Instance, and those for the
solicitors shall be the same as those prescribed for provincial fiscals."
Done at the City of lianila, this low day of larch, in the yoar of
Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-five, and of the Commonwealth of
the Philippines, the tenth.
Solo Benzine
President of the Philippines
By the President:
Secretary to the President
